title: DC-area forecast: Showers and downpours tonight; drying out and breezy for Columbus Day
subtitle: HAPPENING NOW: Scattered showers and a few downpours continue this evening with temperatures in the upper 50s to mid-60s.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Scattered showers and downpours continue this evening with temperatures in the upper 50s to mid-60s.

What’s next? Showers exit early Monday with slowly increasing sun, a gusty breeze, and highs near 70. Sunny and warm Tuesday and Wednesday with highs near or above 80, then cooler and cloudier Thursday behind a front.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Scattered showers continue this evening and overnight. Another quarter to half inch of rain is likely, with locally an inch or more possible under heavier downpours. That could cause ponding and minor flooding in poor-drainage spots. Lows are in the upper 50s to low 60s. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Columbus Day): Lingering showers should taper off by around 8 a.m. Clouds are slow to break, but partial sunshine arrives by afternoon, making it a decent window to get out and dry off. Highs are within a few degrees of 70. Winds from the northwest blow around 10 to 15 mph, with gusts near 25 mph. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Mostly clear as winds fade during the evening. Cool and comfortable, with lows in the 50s. Confidence: Medium-High

A look ahead

Abundant sunshine Tuesday and noticeably warmer with highs in the upper 70s to low 80s. A spotty shower is possible Tuesday night with lows in the 60s. Confidence: Medium-High

As we approach mid-month, Wednesday looks to be mostly sunny and even warmer with highs around 80 to 85. A cold front comes through Wednesday night with lows in the upper 50s to near 60. Confidence: Medium

Partly sunny and turning cooler Thursday with highs in the mid-60s to near 70. Confidence: Medium

Today’s daily digit — 3/10: Isaias soaks our Sunday, even if rain lets up by afternoon, with gusty breezes and a rumble of thunder. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.
